But pricing is very very high compared to other airlines, I flew from Kabul to Dubai for $389 USD and I had a connection to Delhi after 2 hours by Fly Dubai airline it cost me $105 USD. Kabul to Dubai is 1683Km and Dubai to Delhi is 2200Km further away than Kabul to Dubai there has to be some control on prices being fair specially Afghan people are very poor people and Kam Air is taking advantage of the shortage of the airlines flying to Afghanistan.

reviews.title: The service is poor and they frequently change the flights date & hour without any previous notice.
reviews.text: This review is long but will save you from a fraud airline: As my parents are living in north part of Afghanistan, I travel frequently to Afghanistan since 2008. As there is no more options (airline) mostly I have to waste my money and risk my life traveling with Kam Air. The last time I had to fly by Kam Air was few month ago during summer holidays. I booked my round trips flight from Geneva to Istanbul (by Turkish airline) Istanbul to Kabul and from Kabul to Mazar e Sharif (north province of Afghanistan) by Kam Air. One week before the first flight I had to change my flights from Kabul to Mazar and contacted Kam Air. They responded after two days and refused to change the date or refund even a percentage of three tickets (me and my two kids). For return from Mazar to Kabul the changed the date of a round trip from Mazar to Kabul and Kabul to Istanbul and from Istanbul I had to fly to Geneva, without informing me. I missed all round trip and had to pay more than 3000$ to re-book all three tickets for two days later. Two days later again while I as in the Mazar e Sharif airport, the Kam Air flight was gone and I had to travel by road and drive nine hours in other to not miss again all my flight to Geneva. After nine hour of drive arriving in Kabul airport our names were not included to the passengers list and again our flights were changed to next day without any previous notice. We hardly managed to take the flight to Istanbul but I had to leave my luggages and I had to travel all way to Istanbul far from my kids as the sets were separated. I contacted them many times to compensate at least few percentage of missed flights which they caused but they didn't respond and even once they asked me for 200$ extra. For a round trip which normally costs 4000$ I paid 8000$ plus time wasting, stress and my daughter got sick. The staffs and customer services are not kind and helpful. They dont know their own system and PROCEDURE to work and behave. Even in their own branch office, they will ask you to contact their customer service. KamAir_is_fraud don't risk your life, time and money with this airline. They turned my holidays to a nightmare.

reviews.title: My first experience of flying with an Afghan airline
reviews.text: Domestic carriers within India had all cancelled their flights to Kabul due to airspace concerns routeing via or around Pakistan, as recent tensions between the two countries had put security onto high alert status. Therefore I had to fly with Kam Air, the second airline carrier of Afghanistan alongside Ariana, whose routeing also took them on a longer path around Pakistan rendering the flight somewhat longer than usual. I wasn't sure what to expect from an airline whose country is a mystery to most, but I was very pleasantly surprised to discover that their aircraft are in good condition and that the service overall was of a very good standard. Onboard it was mostly post graduate students returning to their home country after studying in Delhi or further afield, and returning passengers who'd been to Delhi to seek medical assistance. Everyone was friendly and the atmosphere on the aircraft was very amenable. The dinner provided was tasty and they offered soft drinks throughout the journey. No immigration paperwork was necessary onboard and I was thoroughly welcomed by all I met to their country. I would be happy to travel with this airline again in the future and look forward to my next visit to Afghanistan.
reviews.author: wjw2018

reviews.title: Very courteous cabin crew...an airline that's really trying its best
reviews.text: Tonight's flight went very smoothly. Check in at Kabul airport was easy, and as the flight was not full they happily booked me a row without other passengers which was very much appreciated. Onboard the 737, there was a little confusion as the rear seat row numbers didn't correspond to the actual seats (!) so I ended up on row 21 instead of 20 as marked on my boarding pass! It was the rear row and I was very pleased to discover that the seats reclined even here. We had an on-time departure, and shortly after take off pillows were provided if requested, followed by a hot meal with choice of chicken or beef. I chose beef, and it was very good, if a tad spicy. There was salad, bread and a custard dessert provided. Unfortunately for me (!) there were only non alcoholic drinks served on this airline, and no inflight entertainment or magazines provided, but that was OK, because after dinner I was able to fold up the armrests and get some sleep. When I awoke I discovered that one of the flight crew, without waking me, had kindly covered me with a blanket which I thought was really sweet. 30 minutes before landing at Istanbul I went to get a glass of water and thanked the cabin crew member who said politely 'it is my duty'... Overall this flight went very well, with good inflight announcements and very attentive polite cabin crew. This is the 4th time I've flown with Kam Air, and their friendly and efficient service, for a country under pressure, is something to be admired and applauded.
reviews.author: wjw2018

reviews.title: Allegedly the best choice out of the two airlines available!
reviews.text: I booked with Kam Air online because I was told that it was the only airline flying to Herat, though I discovered at the airport that this wasn't the case. But everyone told me, as it's a private airline, it's somewhat safer than the only other government airline also plying the route. The check-in lady agent was very amenable but she seemed a bit hesitant to give me a window seat which was odd as the flight wasn't full. I managed to get a window seat eventually by swapping rows onboard after all passengers had boarded. The aircraft was an old Ukraine Wings 737 that had been repainted...the original safety instruction card was in the seat back pocket! I have to say the scenery en-route was SPECTACULAR! Flying over the desert and mountains of the Afghan interior was amazing! During the hour long flight we were given a small juice box and a really greasy, unrecognisable donut/bread thing which wasn't good at all and just left oil everywhere. They had tea available too. Onboard inflight announcements were made in English and the cabin crew were courteous and immaculately dressed. The whole experience deserves a good average rating because there was nothing outstanding about the airline but their safety procedures were adequate and the scenery along the way made the whole trip worth it.
reviews.author: wjw2018

reviews.title: Friendly stuff, on time, old very old aircrafts
reviews.text: Have been booked on a flight from Kabul to Mazar and back with Kam Air. Ground Staff was friendly and helpful, even though their english was limited, so are my Afghan language skills. Boarding was almost on time. Staff was very friendly and the flight and return went very smooth. 40 Minutes flight and you get a meal box with a sort of sandwich, Minute Maid Apple Juice, something sweet and a natural yoghurt. Aircrafts are very old, really old. I can‘t say anything about their maintenance status but I could imagine it is not according to EU or US standards. All in all a positive experience, for sure not comparable with the global market leaders.

reviews.title: Worst airline ever
reviews.text: Cancelled my return tickets with no notice when I landed in Dubai. Gave no excuse and refused to book me on another flight. Luckily staff at Dubai airport very helpful and managed to contact some staff at Kam Air in the middle of the night. Offered me paid admission to Mirahan Lounge in airport, and in the morning, I decided to get aggressive. Kam Air finally agreed to pay for ticket to Kabul on another airline but refused to reimburse the return ticket from Kabul back to Dubai. Offices in Kabul and Herat insisted that reimbursement will be credited to my charge card, so after returning home waited too long for insurance claim as they kept stating that the credit is being processed. Phoned, emailed, and wrote their head office (address on website stated it is located in Dubai) but letter returned by post to say "no such address"!!!. So, I lost the money for the return ticket. Never actually boarded any of their planes, but service was non existent. Will never recommend anyone flying this airline.
